# Functions

As we have to do several analysis multiple times, we will put these into functions to reduce the lines of code. 
```{r, echo = F}
#' Uses a linear model to calculate p-values and R2 for Nagelkerke and Cox & Snell measures 
#' from a data table
#'
#' @param dt         input data table including the Polygenic Risk Scores
#' @param threshold  threshold to calculate the p-value and R2 for
#' @return           the matrix including p-value and R2 for the model with and without covariates
GetPvalueAndR2 <- function(dt, threshold){
  # without correcting for covariates
  lm_no_cov <- lm(dt$Dx ~ dt[, get(threshold)])
  r2_nk_no_cov <- nagelkerke(lm_no_cov)$Pseudo.R.squared.for.model.vs.null["Nagelkerke (Cragg and Uhler)", "Pseudo.R.squared"]
  r2_cs_no_cov <- nagelkerke(lm_no_cov)$Pseudo.R.squared.for.model.vs.null["Cox and Snell (ML)", "Pseudo.R.squared"]
  sum_no_cov <- summary(lm_no_cov)
  #p_val_no_cov <- pf(sum_no_cov$fstatistic[1], sum_no_cov$fstatistic[2], sum_no_cov$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
  p_val_no_cov <- sum_no_cov$coefficients[, 4][2]
  # with correcting for covariates
  lm_cov <- lm(dt$Dx ~ dt[, get(threshold)] + dt$Age + dt$Sex + dt$C1 + dt$C2 + dt$C3 + dt$C4)
  r2_nk_cov <- nagelkerke(lm_cov)$Pseudo.R.squared.for.model.vs.null["Nagelkerke (Cragg and Uhler)", "Pseudo.R.squared"]
  r2_cs_cov <- nagelkerke(lm_cov)$Pseudo.R.squared.for.model.vs.null["Cox and Snell (ML)", "Pseudo.R.squared"]
  sum_cov <- summary(lm_cov)
  p_val_cov <- sum_cov$coefficients[, 4][2]
  # generate matrix including all important scores
  mat <- cbind(c(r2_nk_no_cov, r2_cs_no_cov, p_val_no_cov), c(r2_nk_cov, r2_cs_cov, p_val_cov))
  colnames(mat) <- c("Without_Cov", "With_Cov")
  rownames(mat) <- c("Nagelkerke_R2", "Cox&Snell_R2", "P-value")
  return(mat)
}

#' Print p-values and R2 for Nagelkerke and Cox & Snell for all scores with 1, 0.01, 0.00000005 
#' (5e-08) and the best threshold, generate a boxplot for threshold 0.01 and return the PRSs
#'
#' @param gwas       name of the GWAS summary statistic to run the calculations
#' @return           data table inclduing all phenotypes and the PRS
EvaluatePRS <- function(gwas){
  # 1. read file of all PRSice-2 output scores and remove first colnames (accidentally generated with PRSice-2)
  prs <- fread(file = paste0(path, "/04_PRSice-2/", gwas, "/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_IDs_changed_noDup_final_", gwas, "_PRSice-2_PRS.all.score"))
  names <- colnames(prs)[-1]
  prs$`1` <- NULL
  colnames(prs) <- names
  summary <- fread(file = paste0(path, "/04_PRSice-2/", gwas, "/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_IDs_changed_noDup_final_", gwas, "_PRSice-2_PRS.summary"))
  best <- as.character(summary$Threshold)
  snps <- fread(file = paste0(path, "/04_PRSice-2/", gwas, "/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_IDs_changed_noDup_final_", gwas, "_PRSice-2_PRS.snp"))
  # 2. add pData information to PRS
  prs <- merge(prs, pData, by = "IID")
  # change Dx to numeric
  prs[prs$Dx == "CTL", "Dx"] <- "0"
  prs[prs$Dx == "CASE", "Dx"] <- "1"
  prs$Dx <- as.numeric(as.character(prs$Dx))
  # 3. get PRS for 1, 0.01, 0.00000005 (5e-08) and best p-value thresholds
  if (!("5e-08" %in% colnames(prs))) {
    prs_new <- prs[, c("IID", "Dx", "Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "1", "0.01", "5.005e-05")]
    colnames(prs_new) <- c("IID", "Dx", "Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "1", "0.01", "5e-08")
  } else if (!("0.01" %in% colnames(prs))) {
    prs_new <- prs[, c("IID", "Dx", "Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "1", "0.01005", "5e-08")]
    colnames(prs_new) <- c("IID", "Dx", "Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "1", "0.01", "5e-08")
  } else {
    prs_new <- prs[, c("IID", "Dx", "Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "1", "0.01", "5e-08")]
  }
  prs_new <- cbind(prs_new, prs[, get(best)])
  colnames(prs_new)[length(prs_new)] <- best
  m1 <- GetPvalueAndR2(prs_new, threshold = "1")
  snp <- cbind(as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < 1, ]$P)), as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < 1, ]$P)))
  rownames(snp) <- "SNPs"
  m1 <- rbind(m1, snp)
  m2 <- GetPvalueAndR2(prs_new, threshold = "0.01")
  snp <- cbind(as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < 0.01, ]$P)), as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < 0.01, ]$P)))
  rownames(snp) <- "SNPs"
  m2 <- rbind(m2, snp)
  m3 <- GetPvalueAndR2(prs_new, threshold = "5e-08")
  snp <- cbind(as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < 5e-08, ]$P)), as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < 5e-08, ]$P)))
  rownames(snp) <- "SNPs"
  m3 <- rbind(m3, snp)
  m4 <- GetPvalueAndR2(prs_new, threshold = best)
  snp <- cbind(as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < as.numeric(best), ]$P)), as.character(length(snps[as.numeric(as.character(snps$P)) < as.numeric(best), ]$P)))
  rownames(snp) <- "SNPs"
  m4<- rbind(m4, snp)
  res <- list(m1, m2, m3, m4)
  names(res) <- c("1", "0.01", "5e-08", best)
  print(res)
  capture.output(res, file = paste0(path, "/08_results/PRSice-2_P-values_and_R2_for_", gwas, ".txt"))
  # 4. Generate boxplot
  col <- viridis(20) # get six colors (for plots)
  # change and relevel Diagnosis column of PRS
  prs_plot <- prs_new[, c("0.01", "Diagnosis")]
  cases <- prs_plot[prs_plot$Diagnosis != "CTL", ]
  cases$Diagnosis <- as.character(cases$Diagnosis)
  cases$Diagnosis <- "CASE"
  prs_plot <- rbind(prs_plot, cases)
  prs_plot$Diagnosis <- factor(prs_plot$Diagnosis, levels = c("CTL", "CASE", "MDD", "BPD", "SCZ"))
  # boxplot of PRS
  ggplot(prs_plot, aes(x = Diagnosis, y = prs_plot$`0.01`, fill = Diagnosis)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Controls", "Cases", "Major depression disorder", "Bipolar disorder", "Schizophrenia")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 26), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.text = element_text(size = 26), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(5), guide = F) +
    ggtitle(paste0("PRS based on ", gwas, " GWAS summary statistic")) + 
    ylab("Polygenic risk score (PRS)") 
  ggsave(paste0(path, "/07_figures/boxplot_PRSice-2_PRS_", gwas, ".pdf"), width = 12, height = 10, units = "in")
  return(prs_new)
}
```

# Correlation Plot

```{r}
# Correlation Plot (only for ADHD-2019, ASD-2019, BIP-2019, CDG2-2019, MDD2-2018, MDD3-2019, SCZ2-2014, EA-2018, T2D-2017)
# Add PRS for different summary statistic files to pData
prs_adhd <- data.frame(IID = adhd_2019_prsice$IID, PRS_ADHD = adhd_2019_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_adhd, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_asd <- data.frame(IID = asd_2019_prsice$IID, PRS_ASD = asd_2019_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_asd, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_scz2 <- data.frame(IID = scz2_2014_prsice$IID, PRS_SCZ = scz2_2014_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_scz2, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_mdd2 <- data.frame(IID = mdd2_2018_prsice$IID, PRS_MDD2 = mdd2_2018_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_mdd2, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_mdd3 <- data.frame(IID = mdd3_2019_prsice$IID, PRS_MDD3 = mdd3_2019_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_mdd3, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_bip <- data.frame(IID = bip_2019_prsice$IID, PRS_BIP = bip_2019_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_bip, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_ea <- data.frame(IID = ea_2018_prsice$IID, PRS_EA = ea_2018_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_ea, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_cdg <- data.frame(IID = cdg2_2019_prsice$IID, PRS_CDG = cdg2_2019_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_cdg, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_t2d <- data.frame(IID = t2d_2017_prsice$IID, PRS_T2D = t2d_2017_prsice$`0.01`)
pData <- merge(pData, prs_t2d, by = "IID", all.x = T)
# Calculate correlations using canCorPairs from the variancePartition package
model <- ~ PRS_SCZ + PRS_MDD2 + PRS_MDD3 + PRS_BIP + PRS_CDG + PRS_ADHD + PRS_ASD + PRS_EA + PRS_T2D + Age + Sex + Dx + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4
corr <- canCorPairs(model, pData_new)
# change orw and column names
colnames(corr) <- c("SCZ-2014", "MDD-2018", "MDD-2019", "BIP-2019", "CDG-2019", "ADHD-2019", "ASD-2019", "EA-2018", "T2D-2017", "Age", "Sex", "Diagnosis", "Ancestry Dim 1", "Ancestry Dim 2", "Ancestry Dim 3", "Ancestry Dim 4")
rownames(corr) <- c("SCZ-2014", "MDD-2018", "MDD-2019", "BIP-2019", "CDG-2019", "ADHD-2019", "ASD-2019", "EA-2018", "T2D-2017", "Age", "Sex", "Diagnosis", "Ancestry Dim 1", "Ancestry Dim 2", "Ancestry Dim 3", "Ancestry Dim 4")
# generate correlation plot and save into a file
corrplot(corr, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", cl.lim = c(0, 1), is.corr = F, col = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "RdBu")))(100))
pdf(paste0(path, "/07_figures/corrplot_covariates_PRS.pdf"))
corrplot(corr, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", cl.lim = c(0, 1), is.corr = F, col = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "RdBu")))(100))
dev.off()
```


# Heatmap 

```{r}
# heatmap for all PRS GWAS
# save only IID and PRS columns
#pData.new <- pData[, c("IID", "PRS_BIP", "PRS_SCZ", "PRS_MDD", "PRS_CD", "PRS_ADHD", "PRS_ASD", "PRS_EA", "PRS_BMI")]
pData_new <- pData[, c("IID", "PRS_MDD2", "PRS_MDD3", "PRS_BIP", "PRS_SCZ", "PRS_CDG")]
# set IIDs as rownames and remove IID column afterwards
row.names(pData_new) <- pData_new$IID
# generate heatmap
anno <- as.data.frame(pData[, c("IID", "Dx", "Sex", "Age")])
rownames(anno) <- anno$IID
anno$IID <- NULL
# generate Age bins (from 18-35, 35-52, 52-70, 70-87)
anno$Age <- cut(anno$Age, breaks = c(18, 35, 52, 70, 88), right = FALSE, labels = c("18-35", "35-52", "52-70", "70-88"))
colnames(anno) <- c("Diagnosis", "Sex", "Age")
# Specify annotation colors
anno_colors = list(Sex = c("M" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[10], "F" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[2]),
                   Diagnosis = c("CTL" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[9], "CASE" = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[3]),
                   Age = c("18-35" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[3], "35-52" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[5], "52-70" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[7], "70-88" = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[9]))
pdf(paste0(path, "/07_figures/heatmap_PRS_SCZ_BIP_MDD2_MDD3_CDG_GWAS.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)
pheatmap(t(pData_new[, 2:length(pData_new)]), scale = "row", cluster_rows = F, annotation_col = anno, annotation_colors = anno_colors, font_size = 0.6, show_colnames = F, 
         cex = 1.5, labels_row = c("MDD-2018", "MDD-2019", "BIP-2019", "SCZ-2014", "CDG-2019"), color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100))
dev.off()
p <- pheatmap(t(pData_new[, 2:length(pData_new)]), scale = "row", cluster_rows = F, annotation_col = anno, annotation_colors = anno_colors, font_size = 0.6, show_colnames = F, 
              cex = 1.5, labels_row = c("MDD-2018", "MDD-2019", "BIP-2019", "SCZ-2014", "CDG-2019"), color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100))
dev.off()
iid.order <- p$tree_col$order
row_names <- as.character(pData_new[iid.order, "IID"])
pData_new2 <- pData[, c("IID", "PRS_ADHD", "PRS_ASD", "PRS_EA", "PRS_T2D")]
row.names(pData_new2) <- as.character(pData_new2$IID)
pData_new2$IID <- NULL
pData_plot <- t(pData_new2[row_names, ])
# generate heatmap
pdf(paste0(path, "/07_figures/heatmap_PRS_ADHD_ASD_EA_T2D_GWAS.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)
pheatmap(pData_plot, scale = "row", cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, font_size = 0.6, show_colnames = F, 
         cex = 1.5, labels_row = c("ADHD-2019", "ASD-2019", "EA-2018", "T2D-2017"), color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")))(100))
dev.off()
```
